description: Apple is working on "Apple Reference Image," a photo provenance system that will verify if an image was captured with an iPhone. According to the text, there will be a "Reference" mode option in the Camera app that users can select. Using this mode will embed provenance data in the image's metadata. Images captured with an opt-in Reference mode can be authenticated to confirm they were taken with an iPhone.
